fixture: Each test created and disposed the existing managed two-Repository fixture and persisted a terminal ReadyForResolution Pass1 pair: both Scan Executions, TwoRepositoryScanCoordination, prepared Scan Context Snapshots, two approved Prepared Scan Manifests with the same pair-package binding, current Code Logic Logical Documents/Document Versions, actual revision-bound Source Anchor and Code Unit SHA-256 values, one Confirmed classification per Repository, embedded catalog identity, and Code Logic JSON containing matching communicationEvidence plus CrossRepository deferredObservations. The baseline uses the complete fixture; each RED changes one fact. The source-hash RED uses an injected deterministic reader expectation and does not mutate the working tree. All tests use disposable SQLite/Git fixtures only; no PostgreSQL, network, or system state was used.
